subject: Marketplace prequalification — technical & compliance evidence pack
messages:
From: Marketplace Procurement <procurement@cloudmarketplace.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudMarketHub vendor prequalification — questionnaire attached

Hi Mina / Vanessa,

Thanks for applying to list Redwood on CloudMarketHub. Attached is our standard prequalification workbook (CMH_Marketplace_Questionnaire.xlsx). We ask vendors to return the completed workbook plus supporting artifacts for the following sections:
- Technical architecture and tenant isolation
- Authentication & identity (SAML/OIDC, SCIM)
- Data residency and encryption (in transit/at rest)
- Compliance posture (SOC 2, ISO, FedRAMP if applicable)
- Billing & metering integration details

Please return a completed file and any supporting PDFs or diagrams within five business days. If you need an extension or have questions about specific fields, let me know.

Also cc'ing our technical lead — they may follow up with a short architecture question after review.

Thanks,
Sandra Park
Senior Vendor Onboarding Manager
CloudMarketHub
procurement@cloudmarketplace.com

Attachment: CMH_Marketplace_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel workbook, 18 sheets)

Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMarketHub vendor prequalification — questionnaire attached

Hi Sandra — thanks for the questionnaire and the timeline. We'll take this on. A few quick clarifications so we can route owners internally:
1) On the tenant isolation tab: do you want a per-tenant VPC/network diagram (preferred) or a logical multi-tenant diagram that highlights namespaces and ACLs?
2) For billing/metering: do you accept a CSV export from our billing system + mapping table, or do you require direct API integration details for initial listing?

We're planning an internal sprint today to compile the artifacts. Looping in Connor (sales lead) to confirm SLAs/pricing matrix. We'll aim to return the workbook + attachments by Tue COB (2027-08-31) and will surface anything we can't provide immediately.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com

Hi Sandra / Tech Lead —

Thanks for your patience. Attached are the completed workbook and supporting artifacts you requested:
- Completed workbook: CMH_Marketplace_Questionnaire.xlsx (filled)
- SOC 2 summary & controls mapping: SOC2_Summary.pdf
- Network/tenant isolation diagram (logical + VPC overlay): network_diagram.png
- Pricing & SLA matrix + billing mapping: pricing_sla_matrix.xlsx

Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example/marketplace-onboarding (same files, PDFs for larger diagrams)

Quick notes on a couple of fields we left as "TBD" in the workbook and our intended follow-up cadence:
- Tenant isolation: Redwood supports both single-tenant VPC deployments (via our Private offering) and logical multi-tenant with strong namespace + ACL separation in Hosted. The attached diagram includes both variants; if you prefer a per-tenant VPC sample, we can provide a sanitized VPC export under NDA.
- Billing/metering: we can supply a CSV export mapping to CMH SKU fields to start. Connor is available to scope API-based metering integration if you require push-based metering.

If the tech lead wants a short walkthrough, we can set a 30-minute window tomorrow morning (Wed 9/1) to go over the network diagram and billing mapping.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference

Mina / team — thanks, received. The artifacts look complete at a first pass. One quick clarifying question on tenant isolation: in the logical multi-tenant diagram you show KV cache shared across pods with namespace-based keys. Can you confirm whether the KV cache supports per-tenant encryption keys or if key separation is achieved only at the application level?

If per-tenant key separation is supported we can mark the isolation requirement as "meets"; otherwise we'll need a mitigations note (example language). A short call would be great — I'll accept the 30-minute slot if available.

Sandra Park
Marketplace Technical Lead
CloudMarketHub
